reasons.description: The domain binding does not identify a versioned ProductCase.
reasons.remediation: Provide a reviewed ProductCase pointer with provenance.

reasons.description: The domain binding does not identify a versioned ProductDefinition.
reasons.remediation: Provide a reviewed ProductDefinition pointer with provenance.

reasons.description: The evidence domain is not declared.
reasons.remediation: Bind the record to one supported P0 domain.

reasons.description: No immutable MeasurementSpec is bound to this domain.
reasons.remediation: Provide and bind the reviewed MeasurementSpec object.

reasons.description: No QCReadinessProfile is bound to this domain.
reasons.remediation: Provide the upstream QC readiness record.

reasons.description: No MeasurementResult is bound to this domain.
reasons.remediation: Provide at least one versioned upstream measurement result.

reasons.description: The domain task validation state has not been assessed.
reasons.remediation: Record the reviewed task validation state.

reasons.description: The MeasurementSpec-side method requirement is not assessed.
reasons.remediation: Declare whether a validated method path is required.

reasons.description: A required method validation record is absent.
reasons.remediation: Provide the applicable immutable validation record.

reasons.description: A required validation, environment, holdout, calibration, OOD, or context check is not assessed.
reasons.remediation: Complete and version the missing validation check.

reasons.description: A required sensitivity kind has no bound record.
reasons.remediation: Provide the required versioned sensitivity record.

reasons.description: A required sensitivity record has not been assessed.
reasons.remediation: Complete the upstream sensitivity assessment.

reasons.description: The MeasurementSpec-side prior requirement is not assessed.
reasons.remediation: Declare whether a prior is required for interpretation.

reasons.description: A required prior-applicability record is absent.
reasons.remediation: Provide the required immutable prior-applicability record.

reasons.description: A required prior context dimension has not been assessed.
reasons.remediation: Complete the missing context match assessment.

reasons.description: Non-identical records in one evidence family have no reviewed supersession decision.
reasons.remediation: Reconcile or version the conflicting family records before gating.

reasons.description: The upstream QC readiness state is not assessed.
reasons.remediation: Complete the upstream QC readiness evaluation.

reasons.description: The declared input is insufficient for the bound MeasurementSpec.
reasons.remediation: Address the upstream QC blockers or use an applicable MeasurementSpec.

reasons.description: The upstream QC contract is not applicable to this measurement path.
reasons.remediation: Select an applicable input and MeasurementSpec contract.

reasons.description: A required upstream sensitivity assessment reports an unstable conclusion.
reasons.remediation: Resolve the sensitivity failure before interpreting this domain.

reasons.description: A required method is outside its reviewed context of use.
reasons.remediation: Use a validated applicable method or extend the validation scope.

reasons.description: A required upstream calibration validation check failed.
reasons.remediation: Resolve and revalidate the calibration failure upstream.

reasons.description: A required upstream OOD validation check failed.
reasons.remediation: Resolve and revalidate the OOD failure upstream.

reasons.description: A required prior mismatches at least one declared context dimension.
reasons.remediation: Use an applicable prior or revise the reviewed requirement.

reasons.description: The upstream QC readiness record declares a documented limitation.
reasons.remediation: Retain the limitation beside any raw-evidence interpretation.

reasons.description: The bound MeasurementSpec is not frozen.
reasons.remediation: Complete MeasurementSpec review before formal use.

reasons.description: The domain task validation remains candidate.
reasons.remediation: Complete task validation before formal use.

reasons.description: A required method validation record remains candidate.
reasons.remediation: Complete and freeze the method validation record.

reasons.description: A required environment validation record remains candidate.
reasons.remediation: Complete and freeze the environment validation record.

reasons.description: Required validation does not cover the declared source family.
reasons.remediation: Add source-family holdout evidence or retain candidate interpretation.

reasons.description: Required validation does not cover the declared modality.
reasons.remediation: Add modality holdout evidence or retain candidate interpretation.

reasons.description: A required upstream sensitivity assessment reports a limitation.
reasons.remediation: Retain the sensitivity limitation beside interpretation.

reasons.description: A required prior has a documented partial context match.
reasons.remediation: Retain the context limitation or supply a fully applicable prior.

reasons.description: The upstream QC record declares the input adequate for the measurement path.
reasons.remediation: No data-readiness remediation is required by this gate.

reasons.description: Required method records are frozen and applicable within their declared scope.
reasons.remediation: Retain the versioned validation provenance.

reasons.description: A frozen deterministic path satisfies an explicit no-learned-model requirement.
reasons.remediation: Retain the deterministic validation provenance.

reasons.description: All required prior context dimensions match or are not required.
reasons.remediation: Retain the versioned prior and snapshot provenance.

reasons.description: The reviewed contract explicitly does not require a prior.
reasons.remediation: Retain the reviewed requirement declaration.

reasons.description: The supplied raw-evidence records satisfy the deterministic gate.
reasons.remediation: Do not interpret this state as a product score or validation claim.

reasons.description: The supplied raw-evidence records are usable only with explicit limitations.
reasons.remediation: Keep every limiting reason beside the raw evidence.

reasons.description: The supplied records do not support interpretation under the current gate.
reasons.remediation: Resolve the listed evidence blocker before interpretation.

reasons.description: Required records are absent, unassessed, or unresolved.
reasons.remediation: Provide or reconcile the listed records before interpretation.

reasons.description: No frozen P0 ScoreContract is available in this release.
reasons.remediation: Keep domain_score null and score_state unavailable.

reasons.description: A score reference is retained only as provenance and cannot enable scoring.
reasons.remediation: Do not interpret or publish a domain score from this run.

reasons.description: Byte-identical records in one evidence family were collapsed deterministically.
reasons.remediation: Use the retained family record and do not count duplicates as votes.
